packages.name: postgres
packages.description: Pure native PostgreSQL client driver for Tarn. Protocol 3.0 over TCP sockets; zero C dependencies.

packages.name: mysql
packages.description: Pure native MySQL and MariaDB client driver for Tarn. Wire Protocol over TCP sockets; zero C dependencies.

packages.name: flame
packages.description: Fast, lightweight and expressive web framework for Tarn. Ergonomic routing, path parameters, middlewares and route groups; zero C dependencies.

packages.name: sqlite
packages.description: Official SQLite driver and safe C FFI bindings for Tarn. In-memory and persistent storage backed by libsqlite3.

packages.name: dbus
packages.description: Session D-Bus calls, name ownership and signals in Tarn. Backed by libdbus-1; Linux x86_64.

packages.name: mongo
packages.description: Pure native MongoDB client driver and BSON engine for Tarn. OP_MSG protocol over TCP sockets; zero C dependencies.

packages.name: redis
packages.description: Pure native Redis client driver and RESP protocol engine for Tarn. In-memory KV, hashes, lists and sets; zero C dependencies.
